decisions.dm_summaries: A summary qualifies only when authored by the DM of a linked selected Quest, then current Document authority applies; player summaries do not substitute.
decisions.location: Exact Document category Locations through shared admission reader; replace obsolete SQL location/% selector in owning implementation. Explicit MapView-only overlay retains the base graph byte-for-byte in unrelated families.
decisions.ordering: Character/admin createdAt DESC/publicUUID DESC. DM sessions played/closed scheduledAt DESC/publicUUID DESC; NULL schedules N/A by retained NOT NULL invariant. Downtime updatedAt DESC/publicUUID DESC. coPlayers questCount DESC/characterUUID ASC/memberUUID ASC. MapView title ASC/document publicUUID ASC/hex publicUUID ASC.
decisions.preview: PLAYER always simulates player-visible blocks, even authorId=self; authorId admits self/admin context and never arbitrary impersonation. Ordinary unknown callouts remain visible; malformed audience/DM markers redact per shared fixture.
